original_annotations: On Walmart, open a product page for the same type of material used in the video—self-adhesive waterproofing tape/membrane intended for protecting deck joists or wooden framing. The listing must state that it is for joists/wood framing, is waterproof/self-adhesive, and is sold as a roll.

observed_events.description: The wearer lays black adhesive barrier tape across the tops of exposed wooden deck joists.

supported_claims.text: Released frames show a black adhesive barrier being fitted along the top faces of exposed wooden deck joists. No product brand or proprietary installation variant is required.

construct.research_question: Can an Agent narrow a scene-grounded reference selection when a later working need requires written step navigation?
construct.belief_before: Reference videos directly about the shown joist-tape protection step are useful, including product explanations and installation walkthroughs.
construct.belief_after: Keep one relevant reference whose public page provides written steps or chapters for locating that installation.
construct.required_behavior_change: Replace an initially useful unoutlined reference with an outlined guide, or retain an already outlined guide; end with exactly one saved video.
construct.no_update_failure: Keep an initially useful reference with no public written installation outline or chapters.
construct.overupdate_failure: Discard an already adequate outlined guide or keep multiple references despite the one-video update.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: Only the released scene identifies the step as adhesive barrier over exposed deck joist tops; neither A nor B names tape, joists, wood, decks or a website entity.

observed.why: B asks for an actual public step outline/chapter list so the user can find the working step later, removing unoutlined references.

difficulty.basis: Match the unnamed visible installation step to the reference, then apply the independent written-navigation requirement.
